About Lions

Lions Barbers is based on Mint Walk in Croydon, with a focus on male grooming. Our approach brings together shape, texture and attention to detail.

Services listed include haircuts, skin fades, beard grooming, shape ups and children's haircuts.

Before you visit

How do I book?

Open Barber Dresser, choose your service and personalise your look. When online bookings open, select an available time or an eligible walk-in place, then review the details before confirming. A preview or unconfirmed selection does not reserve a chair.

Can I pay by card?

Check the payment choices shown for your booking or ask the shop before your visit. Online payments and deposits are only available when explicitly offered by the platform.

Is the shop accessible and child-friendly?

Please contact Lions directly through Instagram or Facebook, or ask in the shop, to discuss access, accompanying children and any support you need before visiting.

Booking is powered by Barber Dresser. Services, prices and hours may change; review your details before confirming. Message Lions on Instagram ↗
